headerDescPart1: Enter progress/cost/outsourcing data for the project. Amounts:
headerDescPart2: (auto-converted to thousand USD on save), progress unit:
progressRowYearRange: Progress row {{rowNo}}: year ({{year}}) must be between 2000 and 2100.
progressRowMonthRange: Progress row {{rowNo}}: month ({{month}}) must be between 1 and 12.
progressRowPercentRange: Progress row {{rowNo}}: {{label}} ({{value}}%) must be between 0 and 100.
completionMissingMonthLimit: Only one completion cost estimate row without a base month is allowed. Please set a base month.
completionDuplicateMonth: The same base month ({{year}}.{{month}}) is entered more than once for the completion cost estimate.
salesMonthlyNote: Reflected in the Revenue tab chart. Entered data takes priority over the main dashboard data. VND amounts are automatically converted to thousand USD on save.
cogsMonthlyNote: Reflected in the Revenue tab's Cost (accounting vs. executed COGS) chart. VND amounts are automatically converted to thousand USD on save.
overviewCostRateNote: Bidding and execution budget amounts entered in the "4. Cost Rate" table below are also reflected in the Overview tab.
overviewCashNote: Reflected in the Overview tab's Project Info, Revenue, and Cash cards. Outstanding is automatically calculated as (A)-(B).
costEstimationNote: Multiple estimated completion cost rate entries can be entered per base month. The Cost tab shows the most recent base-month value at or before the end of the selected period.
costBudgetNote: Enter Common·Expense 1 (Direct Cost) and Expense 2·Contingency (Indirect Cost) here. Outsourcing-type budget/execution actuals are automatically aggregated from the "Outsourcing/Materials" table below.
monthlyPlanActualNote: Displayed in the Budget Execution Status card based on the selected month. Outsourcing items can also be entered.
cashflowNote: Enter cash out as a positive number (the chart automatically displays it downward). VND amounts are automatically converted to thousand USD on save.
cashflowPrefilledNote: Data saved in the Cash Flow Excel (DB) has been loaded. If you edit the table, it will be saved as this project's cash flow data, and the saved values will take priority afterward.
photoEmpty: No photos registered. Upload using the button above.
